title: Invalid State Admissions Benchmark: admission cases and disposition scorer
description: A benchmark for what stateful AI systems write into shared state. Version 2.0.0 adds 39 synthetic cases in 12 families with system-visible inputs separated from ground truth, declared rules and target contracts, a Level 2 stateful runner that scores persisted records and served answers through an architecture-neutral adapter contract, and the metrics OAR, IPAR, VSAR, CDR, SRA, UFR, DLR and CPR with critical failures and exact intervals. Measured baselines: always-reject, always-hold, always-admit and a non-LLM reference rules baseline written with knowledge of the public cases (its public-set score is an illustration, not evidence of generality; a probe set shows its brittleness). Language-model baselines are provided as a runnable harness and have not been run. No result is reported for any AI system. The v1.0.0 cases and scorer are kept unchanged under v1/. Code: MIT.
